dayNotePrefix: Walk or bike the 3 closed miles of Cascade River Road from the Eldorado gate to the Cascade Pass trailhead first.

roadPatch.status: Closed to vehicles at the Eldorado gate near mile 20 for maintenance as of late October 2026, with no reopening date; walkers and bikes can pass, which adds about 3 miles each way to the Cascade Pass trailhead.

why: WTA 2026-10-15 wta.org/news/signpost/...cascade-river-road-closure-10-15-26 (closed at MP 20 until further notice, foot/bike allowed) and wta.org/go-hiking/hikes/cascade-pass (road 23 mi from Marblemount), read 2026-10-29. 23-20 = 3 mi one way (inferred). Gain of the road (~1500 ft) appears in one route text only, so walkGainFt omitted. Stored day miles start at the Cascade Pass trailhead (day1 5.7/6.5/5.7 mi), so the road is not included. Row status says roughly 4 mi; sources give 3.
